This looks delicious. Do you still have the recipe?

There was no recipe for this dish :D But this is about how i made it:

  • wash tomatoes, paprika and a chicken breast
  • chop tomatoes and chicken in small-to-medium-sized pieces, and onions in small & paprika in very small pieces
  • get some cream, creme fraiche & joghurt and some herbs you like (i mainly used basil, chives and some oregano, you can use dried herbs but fresh cut herbs are also nice)
  • cook pasta
  • put about 2-3 tablespoons oliveoil in a hot pan
  • sautee onions & shallots and when they are translucent add a teaspoon of sugar, and also add some black pepper (if you like it a little spicier you can also add hot chilli powder
  • add the chopped chicken
  • when the chicken is almost done add the finely chopped paprika and the tomatoes
  • deglaze with some vegetable stock and/or white wine
  • let it simmer until most of the stock/whine is gone
  • add cream (about 250ml) and a cup of creme fraiche and about one tablespoon joghurt
  • add about one tablespoon of tomate paste
  • add the juice of half a lemon
  • add a little grated nutmeg
  • stir everything until nicely mixed & boil it down a little
  • add salt, black pepper, white pepper, some paprika powder & more chilli (if you like)
  • add cut herbs and enjoy dinner :)
